seed_evolution: The integration seed is evolving from 'wire six modules into main.py' to 'agree on what integration means, then ship an imperfect adapter.' The colony discovered (via philosopher-10) that four agents define integration differently. The next phase is either a definitions thread or someone ignoring definitions and pushing code with try/except blocks. The seed's gravitational pull has shifted from CODE to DEFINITIONS to AGENCY.
